ws = "/workspace/dumps/workspace"

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(os.path.join(ws, "CollegeNameID.xlsx"), data_only=True)
table = {}
for sheet in wb.sheetnames:
    for row in wb[sheet].iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
        if row[0] is None:
            continue
        table[str(row[0]).strip()] = (str(row[2]).strip(), str(int(row[1])))

# --- Identify OS HW3 files by content ---
files = [f for f in os.listdir(ws) if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(ws, f))]
os3 = []
for f in files:
    with open(os.path.join(ws, f), 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='replace') as fh:
        c = fh.read()
    if "Operating Systems Assignment 3" in c and "Operating Systems HW3" in c:
        os3.append(f)

# --- Create directories ---
ext_dir = {'.c': 'C', '.rs': 'Rust', '.py': 'Python'}
for d in ("os_hw3", "os_hw3/C", "os_hw3/Rust", "os_hw3/Python"):
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(ws, d), exist_ok=True)

# --- Rename & move ---
moved = []
for f in sorted(os3):
    nm = re.match(r"^(.+?)[-_]", f).group(1)
    college, sid = table[nm]
    ext = os.path.splitext(f)[1].lower()
    new_name = f"{nm}-{college}-{sid}-OS-HW3{ext}"
    src = os.path.join(ws, f)
    dst = os.path.join(ws, "os_hw3", ext_dir[ext], new_name)
    assert not os.path.exists(dst), f"collision: {dst}"
    os.rename(src, dst)
    moved.append((f, new_name, ext_dir[ext]))

print("Moved:", len(moved))
from collections import Counter
print(Counter(m[2] for m in moved))

# --- Delete remaining code files (non-HW3) ---
remaining = [f for f in os.listdir(ws) if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(ws, f))]
deleted = []
for f in remaining:
    ext = os.path.splitext(f)[1].lower()
    if ext in ('.c', '.rs', '.py'):
        os.remove(os.path.join(ws, f))
        deleted.append(f)
    else:
        print("KEPT (non-code):", f)

print("\nDeleted original code files:", len(deleted))
print("\nRemaining in workspace root:")
for f in sorted(os.listdir(ws)):
    print("  ", f)
"}

import re
body = re.sub(r'\[Product Name \d\] - Original Price: \[Original Price\] - Promotional Price: \[Promotional Price\]\n?', '', template)
# Insert product lines after "Featured Clearance Items:" header
marker = "🔥 Featured Clearance Items:\n\n"
body = body.replace(marker, marker + prod_lines + "\n")

def fill(name):

for n in ["John Zhang", "Mike Li", "Tom Wang"]:

    print(fill(n))
EOF", "description": "Generate email bodies from template for each subscriber"}

<p dir="auto">4 new classes have been added:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><code>3D scenes</code> with keywords <code>3d reconstruction</code>, <code>novel view synthesis</code>, <code>nerf</code>, and <code>gaussian splatting</code>.</li>
<li><code>speech</code> with keywords <code>speech synthesis</code>, <code>text-to-speech</code>, and <code>speech recognition</code>.</li>
<li><code>molecules</code> with keywords <code>drug discovery</code> and <code>molecule generation</code>.</li>
<li><code>PDEs</code> with keywords <code>partial differential equations</code>, <code>dynamical systems</code>, <code>pdes</code>, and <code>pde</code>.</li>

</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">Note that when new classes are added they are used for the whole dataset (newly added papers but also older papers). That means that labels for some papers may be different to older versions of the dataset, since an older paper may belong now to an newly added class.</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>May 2025:</strong> added full information on ICLR 2025 submissions. Fixed some bugs in scraping of 2017--2018 submissions. Added a new column with OpenReview IDs of each author (starting with 2021).</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Oct 2024:</strong> added blind submissions to ICLR 2025 and new labels.</p>
<p dir="auto">Labels are the same as for the 2024 dataset (see paper), except for:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>
<p dir="auto">class <code>contrastive learning</code> and <code>self-supervised learning</code> have been merged.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto">keyword <code>semantic segmentation</code> has been added to the class <code>object detection</code>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto">keyword <code>multi-agent</code> has been added to the class <code>multi-agent RL</code>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto">keywords <code>bert</code> and <code>text generation</code> have been added to the class <code>LLMs</code>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto">For all keywords where it makes sense, plural has been aded (e.g. <code>adversarial attack</code> and <code>adversarial attacks</code>).</p>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto">6 new classes have been added:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><code>safety</code> with keywords <code>ai safety</code> and <code>safety</code>.</li>
<li><code>alignment</code> with keywords <code>alignment</code> and <code>rlhf</code>.</li>
<li><code>code generation</code> with keywords <code>code generation</code> and <code>program synthesis</code>.</li>

<li><code>neuroscience</code>.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Apr 2024:</strong> The workshop paper is finalized and published as camera-ready. Dataset version 24v2 is shared here.</p>

@dataclass
class SystemPrompts:
    """系统提示信息"""
    agent: Union[str, Dict]
    user: Union[str, Dict]
    
    @classmethod
    def build(cls, task_dir: str, cn_mode: bool=False):
        if cn_mode:

            user_sp_path = Path("tasks")/task_dir/"docs"/"user_system_prompt.md"
        if agent_sp_path.exists():

        else:
            agent_sp = None
        if user_sp_path.exists():
            with open(user_sp_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                user_sp = f.read()
        else:
            user_sp = None
        return cls(agent=agent_sp, user=user_sp)

    def apply(self, agent_workspace: str, 
              task_str: str,
              time: str,
              single_turn_mode: bool=False,
              cn_mode: bool=False):

        if self.agent is not None:
            self.agent = self.agent.replace("!!<<<<||||current_working_dir||||>>>>!!", os.getcwd())
            self.agent = self.agent.replace("!!<<<<||||workspace_dir||||>>>>!!", os.path.abspath(agent_workspace))
            self.agent = self.agent.replace("!!<<<<||||workspace_dir_rela||||>>>>!!", os.path.relpath(agent_workspace))
            self.agent = self.agent.replace("!!<<<<||||time||||>>>>!!", time)
            if single_turn_mode:
                if not cn_mode:
                    self.agent+="\nPlease complete the given task independently. Do not seek confirmation or additional feedback from the user. You should handle all situations on your own, as the user will not provide any further information."

                    self.agent+="\n请独立完成给定的任务。不要寻求用户的确认或额外的反馈。你应该自己处理所有情况，因为用户不会提供任何进一步的信息。"
        if self.user is not None:
            self.user = self.user.replace("!!<<<<||||task_description||||>>>>!!", task_str)
        return self

    def __post_init__(self):
        """在初始化后自动设置默认值"""
        assert self.task_dir is not None, "task_dir is required"
        assert len(Path(self.task_dir).parts) == 2, "task_dir must be a relative path under tasks/ with format 'split/task_name'"

        if self.task_root is None:
            self.task_root = self.task_dir
        
        if self.id is None:
            self.id = '-'.join(Path(self.task_dir).parts)

        prefix = ''
        if self.cn_mode:
            prefix = 'Chinese-'
        if self.single_turn_mode:
            prefix += 'SingleUserTurn-'

        # 给task_root的最后一级加一个single_user_turn前缀， 如 xx/yy变为xx/SingleUserTurn-yy
        task_root_parts = Path(self.task_root).parts
        if len(task_root_parts) >= 1:
            # 获取最后一级目录名并添加前缀
            last_part = task_root_parts[-1]
            new_last_part = f"{prefix}{last_part}"
            # 重新构建路径
            new_parts = list(task_root_parts[:-1]) + [new_last_part]
            self.task_root = str(Path(*new_parts))
        
        # 使用 Path 对象处理路径
        task_root_path = Path(self.task_root)
        
        # 规范化 task_root（保持字符串格式以保持向后兼容）
        self.task_root = str(task_root_path)

        if self.task_str is None:
            if self.cn_mode:
                task_str_path = Path("tasks")/self.task_dir/"docs"/"task_cn.md"
            else:
                task_str_path = Path("tasks")/self.task_dir/"docs"/"task.md"
            with open(task_str_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                self.task_str = f.read()

        # 从global task config载入dump_path并更新task_root_path, 方便多次测量前后互不影响
        if self.global_task_config is not None and "dump_path" in self.global_task_config:
            # 把modelname拼在global_task_config.dump_path后面
            global_dump_path = self.global_task_config['dump_path']
            if global_dump_path.endswith(self.agent_short_name) or global_dump_path.endswith(self.agent_short_name+'/'):
                pass
            else:
                global_dump_path = Path(global_dump_path)/Path(self.agent_short_name)
            self.task_root = str(global_dump_path / task_root_path)
            task_root_path = Path(self.task_root)
        
        if self.global_task_config is not None and self.global_task_config.get('direct_to_dumps', False) and "dump_path" in self.global_task_config:
            self.task_root = self.global_task_config['dump_path'] # dumps
            task_root_path = Path(self.task_root)

        # task_root 确保为绝对路径
        self.task_root = os.path.abspath(self.task_root)

        # 如果没有指定 log_file，自动生成
        if self.log_file is None:
            self.log_file = str(task_root_path / "log.json")
        self.log_file = os.path.abspath(self.log_file)
        
        # 如果没有指定 agent_workspace，自动生成
        if self.agent_workspace is None:

        self.agent_workspace = os.path.abspath(self.agent_workspace)

        if self.global_task_config is not None and "max_turns" in self.global_task_config:

        if self.global_task_config is not None and "max_steps_under_single_turn_mode" in self.global_task_config:
            self.max_steps_under_single_turn_mode = self.global_task_config['max_steps_under_single_turn_mode']
        
        self.system_prompts.apply(self.agent_workspace, 
                                  self.task_str, 
                                  self.launch_time,
                                  self.single_turn_mode,
                                  self.cn_mode)

        # if self.local_token_key_session is None:

    def load_local_token_key_session(self) -> None:
        token_key_session_path = str(Path("tasks")/ self.task_dir / "token_key_session.py")

        if Path(token_key_session_path).exists():
            # 使用 importlib.util 来从文件路径导入模块
            spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("token_key_session", token_key_session_path)
